Add the contents of the **Mortar** to the **Cauldron**
Add **x1 Belladonna** to the **Cauldron**
**Lower** the **Cauldron**
Put **x1 Chamomile** into the **Mortar** and **Grind** it
Add the contents of the **Mortar** to the **Cauldron**
While the animation is playing, repeatedly press the **Raise Cauldron** button
**Pour** the contents of the **Cauldron** into a **Phial**
Add **Water** to the **Cauldron**
Put **x2 Eyebright** into the **Mortar** and **Grind** it
Add the contents of the **Mortar** to the **Cauldron**
Add **x1 Belladonna** to the **Cauldron**
**Lower** the **Cauldron**
While the animation is playing, repeatedly press the turn **Hourglass** button
Just before the **Hourglass** runs out, turn the **Hourglass** again
When the **Hourglass** is halfway, put **x1 Chamomile** into the **Mortar** and **Grind** it
Put the contents of the **Mortar** into the **Dish**
**Raise** the **Cauldron**
Add the contents of the **Dish** to the **Cauldron**
**Pour** the contents of the **Cauldron** into a **Phial**

effects.text: You gain enhanced night vision for 10 minutes.
